# netactuate_platform_status (Data Source)

Reads Platform Status visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_status" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) Platform status services returned by the API, sorted by service name. Service names are API data and are not a fixed set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (String)
- `locations` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--services--locations))
- `service` (String)

<a id="nestedobjatt--services--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services.locations`

Read-Only:

- `last_updated` (String)
- `location` (String)
